answer: The ridge counter is kept in terrace and comet exposes each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that forfeits. The attacker spends 165 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
